answer: Treat each identity as a single-file queue for scarce grader slots. Before an account can vote or draw full emission, it must collect a pearl of three independently sealed grades on original answers, assigned only after a commit-reveal so copycats cannot peek. A voyage of cloned keys still competes for the same limited panel, so farm throughput does not scale with wallet count. A velvet similarity gate then voids near-duplicate reveals and slashes a small bonded deposit. Cheap replicas stall in the queue; only sequentially earned, non-transferable grades unlock influence.
